decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The building hereby approved shall be used strictly for storage purposes associated with the use of the restaurant at 321 Vicarage Farm Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the east and south walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 7am and 7pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 8 - Within one month of the completion of the outbuilding hereby approved, the area between the outbuilding and access way must be surfaced with a hard surface that is porous or is otherwise drained within the site in accordance with details which must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey detached outbuilding to rear of site
